name: external_forced_conv_plates
title: External forced convection over a flat plate (function library)
summary: Four EES FUNCTIONs returning the average Nusselt number of an isothermal flat plate in crossflow at constant surface temperature: Baehr-Stephan (laminar, piecewise in the Prandtl number), Churchill-Ozoe (laminar, one equation for the whole range), Schlichting (turbulent, with the surface-friction term of that formulation) and Kreith (turbulent). Re on the plate length and the bulk Prandtl number are arguments; the average heat-transfer coefficient follows from h = Nu*k/L and is left to the caller.

authors: H. D. Baehr and K. Stephan (Baehr-Stephan correlation)
S. W. Churchill and H. Ozoe (Churchill-Ozoe correlation)
H. Schlichting and K. Gersten (Schlichting correlation)
F. Kreith, R. Manglik and M. Bohn (Kreith correlation)
origin.notes: ht 1.2.0, commit 85e0ee6 (2025-12-07), file ht/conv_external.py, MIT license, Copyright (C) 2016 Caleb Bell. The scientific basis of each correlation is the original paper or book cited in its function comment block (Baehr & Stephan, Heat and Mass Transfer, Springer 2013, with the 0.664 equation as in Bergman et al. 6E and VDI Heat Atlas G4; Churchill & Ozoe 1973; Schlichting & Gersten, Grenzschicht-Theorie, 9th ed. 1997, with the VDI Heat Atlas; Kreith, Manglik & Bohn 2010). The Prandtl branch limits of Nu_horizontal_plate_laminar_Baehr are those of the ht code (Pr < 0.005, < 0.05, < 10), which reproduces the published values; its docstring quotes 0.6 < Pr < 10 for the 0.664 equation (as in the original). The selectors Nu_external_horizontal_plate(_methods), the conv_horizontal_plate_*_methods dictionaries and the LAMINAR_TRANSITION_HORIZONTAL_PLATE constant are not translated (dispatchers / a constant of the calling model). Translation published under the CoolSolve_Library MIT license (decision D3).

verification.reference: case A: the eight values published by ht 1.2.0 - the four doctests of ht/conv_external.py (one per correlation) and the four Prandtl branches of the ht/tests/test_conv_external.py regression test of Nu_horizontal_plate_laminar_Baehr - plus one further call at Pr = 0.01 (the 0.005 to 0.05 branch, for which ht publishes no value) and the values of case B, computed with the same ht functions in a throw-away virtualenv (local clone); 13 output values in total
verification.notes: compare_solution.py: 13 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=0.001); only in EES: 0; only in CoolSolve: 6 (the six inputs of the demonstration program). Largest relative deviation 2.5e-13 (Nu_horizontal_plate_laminar_Baehr_B), i.e. round-off in the double-precision evaluation only.
